claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Loperamide is a peripherally restricted opioid receptor agonist that at 2.5 uM is unlikely to kill cancer cells through its annotated opioid activity; any modest antiproliferative effect would most plausibly reflect nonspecific off-target activity such as calcium channel blockade or cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress rather than a targeted cytotoxic mechanism.
